change: Sort admitted edges once by vertical start; admit reached edges and remove expired edges while scan rows advance; compute and sort crossings only for active edges
memory: Additional managed usize index buffer with exact edge count; every edge, crossing, index and output allocation remains under caller MemoryBudget

regression: 100 disjoint one-row rectangles on a 1x1000 page; all pixels exact with max_work 30000. Prior full scanning needs at least 200000 edge checks alone
performance_claim_limit: Verified work cap, not measured wall-clock throughput or general speedup
remaining: Stroke rasterization, color pixel qualification, bbox-to-viewer integration, real document throughput
